sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的最新作品，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: January 2009, southeastern Australia was impacted by a blistering heatwave considered to be one of the most, if not the most, extreme in the region's history.
sentences.zh: 2009年1月，澳大利亚东南部遭遇了一场酷热的极端热浪，这被认为是该地区历史上最极端（如果不是唯一的话）的热浪之一。

sentences.en: It caused prolonged, record-breaking temperatures that reached nearly 50 degrees Celsius in some locations.
sentences.zh: 它导致气温持续升高并打破纪录，部分地区气温接近50摄氏度。

sentences.en: In the state of Victoria, this extreme heat caused power outages that resulted in the termination of public transport services and traffic light failures.
sentences.zh: 在维多利亚州，极端高温导致电力中断，公共交通服务被迫终止，交通信号灯也出现故障。

sentences.en: Large public venues in the city of Melbourne were evacuated, and the annual Australian Open Tennis Tournament was also impacted, with several outdoor matches cancelled.
sentences.zh: 墨尔本市的大型公共场所进行了疏散，一年一度的澳大利亚网球公开赛也受到波及，多场户外比赛被迫取消。

sentences.en: American tennis champion Serena Williams remarked that it was so hot on court that she felt she was having an out-of-body experience.
sentences.zh: 美国网球冠军塞雷娜·威廉姆斯表示，球场上的温度高到让她感觉自己仿佛灵魂出窍。

sentences.en: People were stranded inside lifts that had ceased operating.
sentences.zh: 人们被困在停止运行的电梯里。

sentences.en: Wooden power poles were witnessed self-igniting, and bushfires blazed across the state.
sentences.zh: 有人目睹木制电线杆自燃，全州各地山火肆虐。

sentences.en: Thousands of citizens required medical treatment, resulting in a 70% increase in emergency calls to Ambulance Victoria.
sentences.zh: 数千名市民需要医疗救助，导致维多利亚州救护车的紧急呼叫量增加了70%。

sentences.en: While the death rate increased by 45%.
sentences.zh: 而死亡率则上升了45%。

sentences.en: By the following month of February, the heatwave had cost the Victorian economy an estimated $100 million.
sentences.zh: 到了次年2月，这场热浪估计已给维多利亚州经济造成了1亿美元的损失。

sentences.en: On Friday, February 6, State Premier John Brumby cautioned Victorians about the extreme weather conditions forecast for the next day.
sentences.zh: 2月6日星期五，州长约翰·布朗比提醒维多利亚州民众注意次日预报的极端天气状况。

sentences.en: Announcing that Saturday, February 7, 2009, would be
sentences.zh: 他宣布2009年2月7日星期六将是

sentences.en: The worst day in the history of the state.
sentences.zh: 该州历史上最糟糕的一天。

sentences.en: Temperatures were once again set to soar above the mid-40s, and a gale-force wind was predicted.
sentences.zh: 气温将再次飙升至45摄氏度以上，且预计会有大风。

sentences.en: A decade-long drought had left much of the Australian landscape incredibly dry, and Victoria alone had missed the equivalent of two years' worth of average rainfall.
sentences.zh: 长达十年的干旱使澳大利亚大部分地区变得极其干燥，仅维多利亚州就缺少了相当于两年平均降雨量的水分。

sentences.en: Premier Brumby encouraged people to cancel plans, avoid travelling, and stay at home.
sentences.zh: 布朗比州长鼓励人们取消计划，避免出行，待在家里。

sentences.en: Warning.
sentences.zh: 警告。

sentences.en: It's just as bad a day as you can imagine, and on top of that, the state is just tinder dry.
sentences.zh: 这会是你所能想象到的最糟糕的一天，更何况，整个州现在简直干燥得像引火物一样。

sentences.en: People need to exercise real common sense tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天人们需要真正运用常识。

sentences.en: Victoria had a long, disastrous history of wildfires,
sentences.zh: 维多利亚州有着漫长而灾难性的山火历史，

sentences.en: and the weather conditions were predicted to be worse than those that preceded the devastating Ash Wednesday and Black Friday bushfires in 1983 and 1939, respectively.
sentences.zh: 而预报的天气状况将比1983年的“灰烬星期三”和1939年的“黑色星期五”山火发生前还要糟糕。

sentences.en: The MacArthur Forest Fire Danger Index, which combined climate data such as temperature, wind speed, and humidity, anticipated a result for February 7, 2009,
sentences.zh: 麦克阿瑟森林火灾危险指数结合了气温、风速和湿度等气候数据，对2009年2月7日的预测结果

sentences.en: that exceeded the algorithm's highest category of extreme.
sentences.zh: 超出了该算法最高等级“极端”的范畴。

sentences.en: Thus, a new category was created, titled, Catastrophic.
sentences.zh: 因此，一个新的类别被创建，命名为“灾难性”。

sentences.en: A total fire ban was declared, and hundreds of firefighting personnel were deployed statewide.
sentences.zh: 全州宣布禁止一切用火，数百名消防人员被部署到全州各地。

sentences.en: As anticipated, the weather on February 7 was sweltering, with many new all-time maximums reached.
sentences.zh: 正如预料的那样，2月7日的天气酷热难耐，许多地方创下了历史最高气温纪录。

sentences.en: Melbourne recorded its hottest ever temperature at 46.6 degrees Celsius.
sentences.zh: 墨尔本记录到了有史以来的最高气温，达到46.6摄氏度。

sentences.en: Throughout Victoria, bushfires ignited, fanned by high winds that blanketed the state in thick smoke.
sentences.zh: 在维多利亚州各地，山火四起，强风助长了火势，浓烟笼罩了整个州。

sentences.en: As their intensity grew, Australia's national broadcaster, the ABC, abandoned its scheduled programming to report solely on the hazardous situation.
sentences.zh: 随着火势加剧，澳大利亚国家广播公司（ABC）放弃了原定节目，全天候报道这一危险局势。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, residents in rural and regional fire-prone areas debated whether they should stay and defend their homes, or evacuate, and risk losing everything.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，农村和易受火灾影响地区的居民们在争论：是留下来保卫家园，还是撤离并冒着失去一切的风险。

sentences.en: Located in the rural region of Gippsland in Victoria's east is the Latrobe Valley.
sentences.zh: 拉特罗布谷位于维多利亚州东部的吉普斯兰农村地区。

sentences.en: An inland district with three major urban areas, Mowee, Morwell, and Taraugan, and six smaller townships, including Churchill.
sentences.zh: 这是一个内陆地区，拥有莫伊、莫威尔和塔劳根三个主要城区，以及包括丘吉尔在内的六个较小的城镇。

sentences.en: Formerly known as Hazelwood, Churchill was purpose-built to accommodate workers involved in the construction and maintenance of the Hazelwood Power Station.
sentences.zh: 丘吉尔原名黑兹尔伍德，是为安置参与黑兹尔伍德发电站建设和维护的工人而专门建造的。

sentences.en: In 1965, the town was renamed in posthumous honour of former British Prime Minister Sir Winston Churchill and grew into a commuter suburb for those working in neighbouring areas.
sentences.zh: 1965年，该镇为纪念已故英国前首相温斯顿·丘吉尔爵士而更名，并发展成为周边地区工作者的通勤郊区。

sentences.en: Located 160 kilometres south-east of Melbourne, Churchill features a commercial centre for its several thousand locals,
sentences.zh: 丘吉尔位于墨尔本东南160公里处，拥有一个服务于数千名当地居民的商业中心，

sentences.en: with wide parklands separating residential areas from industrial estates.
sentences.zh: 宽阔的公园绿地将住宅区与工业区隔开。

sentences.en: Dense tree plantations, a national park, and acreages of farmland frame the township, which is home to the scenic Lake Highland, and a golden tower known locally as the Big Cigar,
sentences.zh: 茂密的树木种植园、国家公园和广阔的农田环绕着这个城镇，这里有风景优美的海兰湖，还有一座当地人称为“大雪茄”的金色塔楼，

sentences.en: after Winston Churchill's trademark smoking habit.
sentences.zh: 得名于温斯顿·丘吉尔标志性的吸烟习惯。

sentences.en: At 1.32pm on Saturday, February 7, 2009, Triple Zero Emergency Services received a call regarding a wildfire just outside Churchill.
sentences.zh: 2009年2月7日星期六下午1点32分，000紧急服务中心接到一个关于丘吉尔郊外山火的报警电话。

sentences.en: The blaze was four kilometres south-east of town, near the intersection of Glendonald Road and Jellif's Outlet,
sentences.zh: 火场位于镇东南四公里处，靠近格伦唐纳德路和杰利夫出口的交叉路口，

sentences.en: two unsealed stretches of winding roadway that cut through the rural outskirts.
sentences.zh: 这是两条穿过农村郊区的蜿蜒未铺砌道路。

sentences.en: It had emerged from the bottom of a natural basin, the Bennett's Creek catchment, which consisted of blue gum, eucalypt, and pine plantations,
sentences.zh: 火灾起源于一个天然盆地——贝内特溪流域的底部，那里种植着蓝桉、桉树和松树，

sentences.en: surrounded by hazardous surface fuels such as shrubs, wire grass, and blackberry bushes.
sentences.zh: 周围覆盖着灌木、铁线草和黑莓丛等危险的地表燃料。

sentences.en: Three minutes after the call, a pilot flying a firefighting aircraft 10 kilometres from Churchill, sighted a column of dark smoke hundreds of feet high,
sentences.zh: 报警三分钟后，一名驾驶消防飞机在距离丘吉尔10公里处飞行的飞行员，看到了一根数百英尺高的浓烟柱，

sentences.en: rising from the fire's location.
sentences.zh: 从火灾现场升起。

sentences.en: Within ten minutes, the flames had travelled roughly one kilometre and were in the vicinity of forests managed by timber company, Hancock Victorian Plantations.
sentences.zh: 十分钟内，火焰蔓延了大约一公里，进入了由汉考克维多利亚种植园木材公司管理的森林附近。

sentences.en: The plantation's surveillance planes, which were overseeing the entirety of the Latrobe Valley that day, were diverted to Churchill to carry out reconnaissance work.
sentences.zh: 当天负责监视整个拉特罗布谷的种植园监视飞机被调往丘吉尔执行侦察任务。

sentences.en: Despite being in its early stages, the fire's behaviour was noted as extreme.
sentences.zh: 尽管处于初期阶段，但火势表现被记录为极端。

sentences.en: By the time first responders arrived, the blaze had spread rapidly and was burning on both sides of Jellif's Outlet.
sentences.zh: 当第一批救援人员到达时，火势已迅速蔓延，并在杰利夫出口的两侧燃烧。

sentences.en: Spotfires began igniting around it, straining resources and impacting efforts to tackle the central inferno directly.
sentences.zh: 火场周围开始出现飞火，这消耗了资源，并影响了直接扑灭中心火场的努力。

sentences.en: Requests were made for more tankers and air support.
sentences.zh: 人们请求更多的水罐车和空中支援。

sentences.en: However, the intense heat was causing water to evaporate before it even hit the ground.
sentences.zh: 然而，强烈的热浪导致水在落地前就蒸发了。

sentences.en: The focus then shifted to warning surrounding communities of the urgent threat.
sentences.zh: 随后，重点转向警告周边社区防范紧急威胁。

sentences.en: Roadblocks were established around the fire as emergency services personnel visited nearby residences to raise the alarm.
sentences.zh: 火场周围设立了路障，紧急服务人员走访附近住户发出警报。

sentences.en: By 2pm, the fire had been raging for almost half an hour and remained out of control, despite the arrival of additional firefighting crews.
sentences.zh: 下午2点，火灾已持续了近半小时，尽管增援的消防队赶到，火势依然失控。

sentences.en: It continued to move in the south-easterly direction, through the broad valley of Bennett's Creek.
sentences.zh: 它继续向东南方向移动，穿过贝内特溪的宽阔山谷。

sentences.en: Aircrew observed the fire cresting the ridge along Jirlang North Road, and by the 50-minute mark, it had travelled about 7km.
sentences.zh: 机组人员观察到火势翻越了吉朗北路沿线的山脊，到50分钟时，火势已蔓延了约7公里。

sentences.en: More spot fires were reported, and by 3pm, the blaze had burned through a pine plantation and damaged a communications tower.
sentences.zh: 更多飞火被报告，到下午3点，大火已烧毁了一片松树种植园，并损坏了一座通讯塔。

sentences.en: Efforts to protect assets continued as emergency relief centres were established in nearby townships.
sentences.zh: 随着附近城镇设立紧急救援中心，保护资产的工作仍在继续。

sentences.en: At 3.20pm, the fire had destroyed its first homestead, at the intersection of Thompson and Jirlang North Roads.
sentences.zh: 下午3点20分，大火烧毁了第一处宅基地，位于汤普森路和吉朗北路的交叉口。

sentences.en: By 5.15pm, it was approaching the slopes of Mount Tassie, 10km due southeast of Churchill, and spotting to the mountain's east side.
sentences.zh: 到下午5点15分，火势已逼近丘吉尔正东南方10公里处的塔西山山坡，并向山的东侧蔓延。

sentences.en: As emergency crews tackled the surrounding spot fires, the apex of the inferno raged onwards.
sentences.zh: 当紧急救援队扑灭周围的飞火时，火场中心依然在猛烈燃烧。

sentences.en: Earlier that day, Australia's Bureau of Meteorology had predicted a severe wind change that would hit Gippsland between 6 and 8pm.
sentences.zh: 当天早些时候，澳大利亚气象局曾预测，一股强劲的风向转变将在下午6点至8点之间袭击吉普斯兰地区。

sentences.en: Shortly before 4 o'clock, their prediction was amended to the window of 5.30 and 7pm.
sentences.zh: 下午4点前不久，他们的预测被修正为下午5点30分至7点之间。

sentences.en: The planning officer responsible for the Churchill fire, unaware of the amendment, told the incident management team to expect it at the midpoint of 7.
sentences.zh: 负责丘吉尔火灾的规划官员在不知情的情况下，告诉事故管理团队预计在7点左右发生。

sentences.en: When the change arrived an hour earlier than anticipated, it sent 70km an hour gusts through the region that suddenly shifted the fire in a northeasterly direction.
sentences.zh: 当风向转变比预期提前一小时到来时，它带来了时速70公里的阵风，突然将火势推向东北方向。

sentences.en: The winds posed a significant threat to aircrafts and forced them to land,
sentences.zh: 强风对飞机构成了重大威胁，迫使它们降落，

sentences.en: as a 15km long uncontrolled flank of fire developed that ran from the origin point near Churchill through to the east side of Mount Tassie.
sentences.zh: 此时形成了一条长达15公里的失控火线，从丘吉尔附近的起源点一直延伸到塔西山的东侧。

sentences.en: As it progressed forward, burning debris rained down and ignited the surrounding vegetation almost instantly.
sentences.zh: 随着火势向前推进，燃烧的碎片如雨点般落下，几乎瞬间点燃了周围的植被。

sentences.en: It was accompanied by an ear-splitting rush of white noise, described by witnesses as the sound of immense pressure, like that of a jet engine.
sentences.zh: 伴随着震耳欲聋的白噪音，目击者形容那是巨大的压力声，就像喷气式发动机一样。

sentences.en: Following this hurricane-like wind change, the fire was at its most dangerous, threatening multiple townships as well as the Wanron State ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 在这场飓风般的风向转变之后，火势达到了最危险的程度，威胁到多个城镇以及旺隆州立森林。

sentences.en: Residents working fervently to defend their homes were now blinded by an all-encompassing blackness composed of smoke and dash.
sentences.zh: 居民们拼命保卫家园，却被烟雾和灰烬构成的全方位黑暗遮蔽了视线。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, the inbound firestorm appeared through the dark like a sunrise.
sentences.zh: 突然间，汹涌而来的火风暴在黑暗中显现，如同日出一般。

sentences.en: Churchill resident Greg Weir stated,
sentences.zh: 丘吉尔居民格雷格·威尔说：

sentences.en: I knew the fire front was coming, you could hear it, you could smell it, you could feel the heat coming up out of the valley.
sentences.zh: 我知道火线要来了，你能听到它的声音，闻到它的味道，能感觉到热浪从山谷里涌上来。

sentences.en: The flames were right there and were the height of the trees and that again.
sentences.zh: 火焰就在那里，有树那么高，甚至更高。

sentences.en: 300 feet high plus.
sentences.zh: 超过300英尺高。

sentences.en: There were big, swirling vortexes, just big swirling masses of flames that would burst and explode out of the treetops.
sentences.zh: 有巨大的漩涡，巨大的火焰团从树顶爆发出来。

sentences.en: Shortly after 6pm, three water tankers belonging to Volunteer Fire Service, the Country Fire Authority,
sentences.zh: 下午6点刚过，隶属于志愿消防服务机构——乡村消防局的三辆水罐车，

sentences.en: were involved in a series of burnovers, wherein their crews were forced to take shelter where possible as the fire entrapped them.
sentences.zh: 遭遇了一系列火场包围，机组人员被迫在可能的情况下寻找掩体，因为他们被大火困住了。

sentences.en: The burnover hit with, quote, great ferocity.
sentences.zh: 火场包围以“巨大的凶猛”袭来。

sentences.en: Firefighter Graham Chesterton recalled,
sentences.zh: 消防员格雷厄姆·切斯特顿回忆道：

sentences.en: I could see embers start to fall, it was like they were coming from everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我看到余烬开始落下，就像它们从四面八方涌来一样。

sentences.en: It became very smoky and everything started to burn rapidly.
sentences.zh: 烟雾变得非常浓，一切都开始迅速燃烧。

sentences.en: There were spot fires on the ground all around me and the trees started burning.
sentences.zh: 我周围的地面上到处都是飞火，树木也开始燃烧。

sentences.en: At that stage, I guessed I had about 10 to 15 seconds until I would have to make a move.
sentences.zh: 当时，我估计我还有10到15秒的时间做出行动。

sentences.en: Within those seconds, the conditions deteriorated so rapidly that I realised it wasn't safe to leave the truck.
sentences.zh: 在那几秒钟内，情况恶化得如此之快，我意识到离开卡车并不安全。

sentences.en: At that time, I did not know where all my crew members were.
sentences.zh: 那时，我不知道我所有的队员在哪里。

sentences.en: I made the decision to make a mayday call.
sentences.zh: 我决定发出求救信号。

sentences.en: I said something along the lines of, we are completely surrounded by fire.
sentences.zh: 我说的大意是：我们完全被火包围了。

sentences.en: The burnover lasted an estimated 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 这次火场包围持续了大约10分钟。

sentences.en: Firefighting crews elsewhere listened as their colleagues frantically broadcast mayday calls over radio, but were unable to approach the scene due to the level of danger.
sentences.zh: 其他地方的消防队听着同事们在无线电中疯狂地发出求救信号，但由于危险程度太高，无法靠近现场。

sentences.en: All they could do was respond.
sentences.zh: 他们唯一能做的就是回应。

sentences.en: There is nothing we can do for you.
sentences.zh: 我们对你们无能为力。

sentences.en: Incredibly, none of the firefighters caught in the burnover lost their lives.
sentences.zh: 令人难以置信的是，被困在火场包围中的消防员无一丧生。

sentences.en: The fire finally slowed at 8pm and by the following day of Sunday February 8, it was mostly brought to a halt, although burning continued in heavily fuelled areas.
sentences.zh: 火势最终在晚上8点减缓，到次日2月8日星期日，火势基本被控制住，尽管在燃料密集的地区燃烧仍在继续。

sentences.en: The Churchill Fire, named after its point of origin, was not officially listed as under control until 11 days later on February 19.
sentences.zh: 以起源点命名的丘吉尔大火，直到11天后的2月19日才正式宣布受控。

sentences.en: More than 600 firefighting personnel battled the blaze, supported by 105 vehicles and appliances.
sentences.zh: 超过600名消防人员参与了灭火，并有105辆车辆和设备提供支援。

sentences.en: In total, it had burnt more than 25,861 hectares and destroyed 145 homes.
sentences.zh: 总共烧毁了超过25,861公顷土地，摧毁了145所房屋。

sentences.en: Elsewhere, 400 separate bushfires had devastated the Victorian landscape, with the most destructive and deadly being the King Lake and Marysville fires in the state's northeaSt.
sentences.zh: 在其他地方，400起独立的山火摧毁了维多利亚州的景观，其中最具破坏性和致命的是该州东北部的金湖和马里斯维尔大火。

sentences.en: Collectively, the fires had released 80,000 kilowatts of heat, the equivalent of 500 atomic bombs.
sentences.zh: 这些火灾总共释放了80,000千瓦的热量，相当于500颗原子弹。

sentences.en: 173 people had perished and 414 were left injured.
sentences.zh: 173人丧生，414人受伤。

sentences.en: More than 2,000 homes and 10,000 kilometres of fence line had been raised, and an estimated 1 million animals were killed.
sentences.zh: 超过2,000所房屋和10,000公里的围栏被夷为平地，估计有100万只动物死亡。

sentences.en: February 7, 2009, became the deadliest bushfire catastrophe in Victoria's history, and was henceforth referred to as Black Saturday.
sentences.zh: 2009年2月7日成为维多利亚州历史上最致命的山火灾难，此后被称为“黑色星期六”。

sentences.en: 58-year-old Alfred Frendo and his wife Elaine lived on Old Calagny Road in Calagny with their youngest son, Mark, who was disabled and in their care.
sentences.zh: 58岁的阿尔弗雷德·弗伦多和妻子伊莱恩住在卡拉尼的旧卡拉尼路上，他们照顾着残疾的小儿子马克。

sentences.en: The couple had made no plans for what they would do if a bushfire ever threatened their livelihoods, as the possibility never really crossed their minds.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇从未计划过如果山火威胁到他们的生计该怎么办，因为这种可能性从未真正出现在他们的脑海中。

sentences.en: On February 7, 2009, a neighbour alerted the Frandos to smoke rising in the direction of Churchill.
sentences.zh: 2009年2月7日，一位邻居提醒弗伦多一家，丘吉尔方向有烟雾升起。

sentences.en: The fire was nearly 15 kilometres away and the couple were certain it would not reach their property.
sentences.zh: 火灾距离近15公里，夫妇俩确信它不会蔓延到他们的房产。

sentences.en: As a precaution, they collected a pump, polypiping and a spray nozzle and connected them to the dam near their house.
sentences.zh: 作为预防措施，他们收集了水泵、聚乙烯管和喷嘴，并将它们连接到房子附近的蓄水池上。

sentences.en: As the fire drew near, Elaine took their son Mark to her parents' house for safety.
sentences.zh: 随着火势逼近，伊莱恩带着儿子马克去她父母家避难。

sentences.en: Alfred remained behind and was soon joined by his eldest son, 27-year-old Scott, who had arrived to help defend his parents' property.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德留了下来，不久后他的长子、27岁的斯科特也赶来帮忙保卫父母的房产。

sentences.en: At 5.59pm, Scott sent his partner a text informing her that although they didn't know exactly how close the fire was, it was very close and they were in trouble.
sentences.zh: 下午5点59分，斯科特给伴侣发了一条短信，告诉她虽然不知道火势到底有多近，但非常近，他们遇到了麻烦。

sentences.en: He then phoned his mother to tell her that the hayshed at the bottom of the paddock was on fire and requested she call the fire brigade.
sentences.zh: 随后他打电话给母亲，告诉她围场底部的干草棚着火了，并要求她报警。

sentences.en: Less than half an hour later, Scott phoned a friend who later recalled.
sentences.zh: 不到半小时后，斯科特给一位朋友打了电话，后者后来回忆道。

sentences.en: He sounded terrified and in a raised voice he said,
sentences.zh: 他听起来很惊恐，大声喊道：

sentences.en: Get some fucking fire trucks here, before the call dropped out.
sentences.zh: 快叫他妈的消防车来，随后通话中断了。

sentences.en: At 6.30pm, a couple evacuating the area drove past Alfred Frandeau's vehicle, which was located about one and a half kilometres from his property
sentences.zh: 下午6点30分，一对从该地区撤离的夫妇开车经过阿尔弗雷德·弗伦多的车，车子位于距离他房产约1.5公里的地方，

sentences.en: and burning on the opposite side of the road.
sentences.zh: 并在道路的另一侧燃烧。

sentences.en: Alfred's body was later found in his car.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德的遗体后来在他的车里被发现。

sentences.en: Sixty metres away, resting in burnt bushland off the road, was Scott Frandeau's vehicle.
sentences.zh: 在60米外，路边烧焦的灌木丛中，是斯科特·弗伦多的车。

sentences.en: His remains were recovered 14 metres from his car.
sentences.zh: 他的遗体在距离车子14米的地方被找到。

sentences.en: It appeared the father and son had made a last-minute decision to evacuate in separate vehicles before Scott had attempted to flee on foot.
sentences.zh: 看来这对父子在斯科特试图徒步逃生前，做出了最后一刻的决定，分别驾车撤离。

sentences.en: When Elaine Frandeau returned home a week after the fires, she broke down upon discovering her house was still standing.
sentences.zh: 当伊莱恩·弗伦多在火灾一周后回到家时，发现房子依然屹立不倒，她崩溃了。

sentences.en: Her husband and son had succeeded in defending the property.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫和儿子成功保住了房产。

sentences.en: For 13 years, Bill and Shirley Gibson had lived in their single-storey red cedar home on Glendonald Road in Hazelwood South.
sentences.zh: 13年来，比尔和雪莉·吉布森一直住在黑兹尔伍德南区格伦唐纳德路上的一栋单层红雪松木屋里。

sentences.en: Built in the 1970s, the house sat on a large, sloping bush block surrounded by woodland.
sentences.zh: 这栋建于20世纪70年代的房子坐落在一块被林地环绕的大型倾斜灌木地块上。

sentences.en: The couple kept their property in neat condition, ensuring the lawn was trimmed and the guttering was clear.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇把房产打理得井井有条，确保草坪修剪整齐，排水沟畅通。

sentences.en: Shortly before 2pm on February 7, 2009, after the Churchill fire arose within two kilometres of their home,
sentences.zh: 2009年2月7日下午2点前不久，在丘吉尔大火蔓延到距离他们家两公里内后，

sentences.en: Bill and Shirley elected to leave the property.
sentences.zh: 比尔和雪莉选择离开房产。

sentences.en: As they packed their car, one of their sons, 49-year-old Colin, drove up to the house.
sentences.zh: 当他们收拾车子时，他们的一个儿子，49岁的科林开车来到了房子前。

sentences.en: He was intent on protecting his parents' home and refused his father's requests to leave.
sentences.zh: 他一心想保护父母的家，拒绝了父亲离开的要求。

sentences.en: Colin was soon joined by his younger brother, 47-year-old David.
sentences.zh: 不久后，科林的弟弟、47岁的戴维也加入了进来。

sentences.en: Both men were experienced in fighting fires.
sentences.zh: 两人都有丰富的灭火经验。

sentences.en: David had been a member of the Country Fire Authority for 25 years and was considered very, very competent when it came to firefighting,
sentences.zh: 戴维曾担任乡村消防局成员25年，在消防方面被认为非常、非常有能力，

sentences.en: while Colin had been a lieutenant in the Queensland Fire Service.
sentences.zh: 而科林曾是昆士兰消防局的一名中尉。

sentences.en: After their parents had left, the brothers spent the afternoon hosing down the house, flooding the gutters with water, dampening cushions on the veranda,
sentences.zh: 父母离开后，兄弟俩整个下午都在用水管冲刷房子，往排水沟里注水，打湿阳台上的垫子，

sentences.en: hanging wet towels over the windows, and filling everything they could with water.
sentences.zh: 把湿毛巾挂在窗户上，并尽可能地装满所有能装水的东西。

sentences.en: They phoned family members as they worked, telling them that they were safe, that the fire was not close by, and that they would leave shortly.
sentences.zh: 他们工作时给家人打了电话，告诉他们自己很安全，火势并不近，他们很快就会离开。

sentences.en: In a call to his mother, David reassured her,
sentences.zh: 在给母亲的电话中，戴维安慰她：

sentences.en: the house is safe mum, don't worry about it, and told her he loved her before hanging up.
sentences.zh: 妈，房子很安全，别担心，并在挂断电话前告诉她他爱她。

sentences.en: At 3.30pm, David spoke over the phone with a police officer stationed at a nearby roadblock,
sentences.zh: 下午3点30分，戴维通过电话与驻扎在附近路障的一名警察交谈，

sentences.en: who warned him to expect very strong winds that could produce very dangerous conditions.
sentences.zh: 警察警告他预计会有非常强劲的风，可能会造成非常危险的情况。

sentences.en: David contacted his son at around 6pm to report that the fire had passed, although he also mentioned, quote,
sentences.zh: 戴维在下午6点左右联系了他的儿子，报告说火势已经过去，尽管他也提到，引用：

sentences.en: something about a wind change.
sentences.zh: 关于风向转变的一些事。

sentences.en: It arrived 15 minutes later.
sentences.zh: 它在15分钟后到达了。

sentences.en: Early the following morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天清晨，

sentences.en: Colin and David Gibson's bodies were found in their parents' destroyed house.
sentences.zh: 科林和戴维·吉布森的遗体在他们父母被毁的房子里被发现。

sentences.en: The only possible escape route had been the 200m driveway to the main road, which, at the time of their deaths, had led directly into the fire.
sentences.zh: 唯一的逃生路线是那条通往主路、长200米的私家车道，而在他们遇难时，那条路直接通向火场。

sentences.en: 51-year-old Alan Jacobs and his 50-year-old wife Miros lived in a brick veneer house with a corrugated iron roof, situated in a densely treed area of Cornella.
sentences.zh: 51岁的艾伦·雅各布斯和他50岁的妻子米罗斯住在一栋带波纹铁皮屋顶的砖面房屋里，房子位于科内拉一片树木茂密的区域。

sentences.en: Their remote, sloped property backed onto a creek and was described by a neighbour as the most beautiful little valley you could ever live in.
sentences.zh: 他们那处偏远、倾斜的房产背靠一条小溪，被邻居形容为“你所能住过的最美丽的峡谷”。

sentences.en: Alan and Miros had been married for 30 years and had two sons, one of whom was overseas.
sentences.zh: 艾伦和米罗斯结婚30年，有两个儿子，其中一个在海外。

sentences.en: Their fire plan was to stay and defend their property, which was equipped with independent power, several sources of water and firefighting equipment.
sentences.zh: 他们的防火计划是留守并保卫自己的房产，那里配备了独立电源、多种水源和消防设备。

sentences.en: They were prepared to take shelter in a workshop garage positioned beneath their house and wait for the fire front to pass, then emerge to extinguish any remaining spot fires.
sentences.zh: 他们准备躲进位于房屋下方的车间车库，等待火线过去，然后再出来扑灭剩余的零星火点。

sentences.en: The workshop was accessed via a roller door and had a concrete base and ceiling, with double brick walls and a large window at one end covered in a steel shutter.
sentences.zh: 车间通过一个卷帘门进入，有混凝土底座和天花板，墙壁是双层砖结构，一端有一扇覆盖着钢制百叶窗的大窗户。

sentences.en: On February 7 2009, Alan and Miros were joined by their son Luke and his friend Nathan Charles, both aged 21.
sentences.zh: 2009年2月7日，艾伦和米罗斯的儿子卢克以及他21岁的朋友内森·查尔斯加入了他们。

sentences.en: They, along with several of their friends, spent the afternoon preparing the Jacobs home for the fire.
sentences.zh: 他们和几位朋友一起，花了一下午时间为雅各布斯家做防火准备。

sentences.en: The fire front was just over the hill, but based on the blazer's migration, it was only expected to skim the edge of the property.
sentences.zh: 火线就在山那边，但根据火势的走向，预计只会掠过房产的边缘。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, discussions were held in relation to staying or evacuating.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们还是讨论了留守还是撤离的问题。

sentences.en: Alan Jacobs told the others that the choice was theirs, that the garage would be a safe haven for those who remained behind.
sentences.zh: 艾伦·雅各布斯告诉其他人，选择权在他们自己，对于留下来的人来说，车库会是一个安全的避难所。

sentences.en: By 6pm, almost everyone had left or was leaving.
sentences.zh: 到下午6点，几乎所有人都已经离开或正在离开。

sentences.en: Nathan Charles was the only person who decided to stay behind with Alan, Miros and Luke Jacobs.
sentences.zh: 内森·查尔斯是唯一决定留下来陪伴艾伦、米罗斯和卢克·雅各布斯的人。

sentences.en: The wind changed soon after, and at 6.44pm, Nathan placed a call to Triple Zero, explaining that the house was on fire and that they were trapped.
sentences.zh: 不久后风向转变，下午6点44分，内森拨打了“000”求救电话，解释说房子着火了，他们被困住了。

sentences.en: He then phoned his father and sounded as though he was saying goodbye, but the call dropped out.
sentences.zh: 他随后给父亲打了电话，听起来像是在告别，但通话中断了。

sentences.en: Nathan's father then received a text from his son that read,
sentences.zh: 内森的父亲随后收到儿子发来的一条短信，上面写着：

sentences.en: Dad, I'm dead.
sentences.zh: 爸爸，我要死了。

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: 我爱你。

sentences.en: The fire destroyed the Jacobs carport, cars, boat, and almost the entire house.
sentences.zh: 大火摧毁了雅各布斯家的车棚、汽车、船，以及几乎整栋房子。

sentences.en: The bodies of Alan, Miros and Luke Jacobs and Nathan Charles were found the following day inside the garage, which remained intact.
sentences.zh: 第二天，艾伦、米罗斯、卢克·雅各布斯和内森·查尔斯的遗体在完好无损的车库内被发现。

sentences.en: A forensic scientist concluded,
sentences.zh: 一位法医科学家总结道：

sentences.en: With the doors closed tightly and the window shuttered, ventilation would be limited.
sentences.zh: 在门窗紧闭的情况下，通风会受到限制。

sentences.en: In the circumstances, with carbon monoxide and dioxide levels increasing and oxygen being consumed in the fire, ventilation could be a critical issue.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，随着一氧化碳和二氧化碳浓度升高，且火灾消耗了氧气，通风可能成为一个关键问题。

sentences.en: All four victims had asphyxiated.
sentences.zh: 四名受害者均死于窒息。

sentences.en: Caligny resident Jenny lived in a single-storey house with her husband, Glenn, and their two young children.
sentences.zh: 卡利尼居民珍妮与丈夫格伦以及两个年幼的孩子住在一栋单层住宅里。

sentences.en: Although their property was bordered by bushland, it was clear of vegetation and trees.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们的房产被丛林环绕，但周围没有植被和树木。

sentences.en: Jenny and Glenn's fire plan was to fight off any floating embers with their basic equipment and to leave if the situation worsened.
sentences.zh: 珍妮和格伦的防火计划是用基本设备扑灭飘来的余烬，如果情况恶化就撤离。

sentences.en: In the early afternoon of February 7, 2009,
sentences.zh: 2009年2月7日下午早些时候，

sentences.en: Jenny dropped her children off at her in-laws and returned home to her husband.
sentences.zh: 珍妮把孩子送到公婆家，然后回到丈夫身边。

sentences.en: She hoped her mother, 51-year-old Annette Lethem, would stay in the comfort of her home as she had an autoimmune disease that limited her ability to move quickly.
sentences.zh: 她希望51岁的母亲安妮特·莱瑟姆能待在舒适的家里，因为她患有自身免疫性疾病，行动不便。

sentences.en: However, at 5.30pm, Annette and her husband Rodney arrived at Jenny's house to help defend the property.
sentences.zh: 然而，下午5点30分，安妮特和丈夫罗德尼来到珍妮家帮忙保卫房产。

sentences.en: They were aware of the smoke and strong winds, but the lack of embers and ash meant there was no indication they should be seriously concerned for their safety.
sentences.zh: 他们注意到了烟雾和强风，但由于没有余烬和灰烬，他们认为没有迹象表明需要为安全感到严重担忧。

sentences.en: Just before 6pm, Rodney received a call from his brother who warned him of the anticipated wind change.
sentences.zh: 下午6点前不久，罗德尼接到兄弟的电话，警告他预期的风向转变。

sentences.en: Neither Rodney nor Glenn understood the implications of this, with Glenn later stating,
sentences.zh: 罗德尼和格伦都不明白这意味着什么，格伦后来表示：

sentences.en: I had no idea that the fire front would be heading directly for us when the wind changed.
sentences.zh: 我根本没想到风向一变，火线会直接朝我们冲过来。

sentences.en: Rodney and I both thought it would horseshoe around us.
sentences.zh: 罗德尼和我都以为火会绕过我们。

sentences.en: By 6.30pm, the power had gone out and the countryside was enveloped by a haunting red glow, prompting Jenny, Glenn, Rodney and Annette to discuss their options.
sentences.zh: 到下午6点30分，电力中断，乡村被一种令人不安的红色光芒笼罩，促使珍妮、格伦、罗德尼和安妮特讨论他们的选择。

sentences.en: When embers started swirling around the property at 7pm, the group decided to evacuate.
sentences.zh: 当晚上7点余烬开始在房产周围盘旋时，一行人决定撤离。

sentences.en: Jenny and Glenn left in separate vehicles, with Rodney and Annette following behind in their ute.
sentences.zh: 珍妮和格伦分乘两辆车离开，罗德尼和安妮特开着皮卡车紧随其后。

sentences.en: Within minutes, cinder was raining down around them like red hot bullets.
sentences.zh: 几分钟内，煤渣像红热的子弹一样倾泻在他们周围。

sentences.en: As Rodney drove, he was confronted by what he described as a massive, fast, furious grass fire.
sentences.zh: 罗德尼开车时，面对的是他所描述的巨大、快速且猛烈的草地大火。

sentences.en: As the fire front rose over the hill and began raining thick black droplets onto his vehicle's windscreen.
sentences.zh: 当火线翻过山头，开始向他车辆的挡风玻璃上喷洒浓稠的黑色液滴时。

sentences.en: Surrounded by fire and unable to see clearly,
sentences.zh: 被大火包围，视线模糊，

sentences.en: Rodney tried to back the ute into a dam, but when it appeared to stall, his panicked wife decided to make a run for the house.
sentences.zh: 罗德尼试图将皮卡车倒进水坝，但当车似乎熄火时，惊慌失措的妻子决定跑向房子。

sentences.en: Annette Lethem opened the passenger side door and leapt out, immediately falling into the fire.
sentences.zh: 安妮特·莱瑟姆打开副驾驶车门跳了出去，随即跌入火海。

sentences.en: Rodney rushed to help, but was unable to save her.
sentences.zh: 罗德尼冲过去帮忙，但没能救下她。

sentences.en: Despite witnessing his wife's death and having sustained severe burns to 40% of his body,
sentences.zh: 尽管目睹了妻子的死亡，且全身40%的皮肤受到严重烧伤，

sentences.en: Rodney went on to battle several spot fires and managed to save his daughter's house.
sentences.zh: 罗德尼还是继续扑灭了几处零星火点，并成功保住了女儿的房子。

sentences.en: In September 2007,
Martin Schultz and his wife Rachel relocated from Queensland to Victoria with their young son and settled into a house on Factory Road in Caligny.
sentences.zh: 马丁·舒尔茨和妻子雷切尔带着年幼的儿子从昆士兰搬到维多利亚州，在卡利尼的工厂路定居。

sentences.en: Martin and Rachel had separated but maintained an amicable relationship.
sentences.zh: 马丁和雷切尔已经分居，但仍保持着友好的关系。

sentences.en: Martin worked in a local brick factory and continued living at the Caligny property with his pet dog, Kelly.
sentences.zh: 马丁在当地一家砖厂工作，并继续带着宠物狗凯利住在卡利尼的房产里。

sentences.en: Martin was home alone on February 7, 2009, when his father-in-law called to inform him about the fire underway in Churchill.
sentences.zh: 2009年2月7日，马丁独自在家，岳父打电话告诉他丘吉尔正在发生火灾。

sentences.en: At around 3pm that day, a neighbour visited to warn Martin of the fire's proximity, estimating that it was only about 10 kilometres away.
sentences.zh: 那天下午3点左右，一位邻居来访，警告马丁火势很近，估计只有10公里远。

sentences.en: Martin was unaware of the danger.
sentences.zh: 马丁并没有意识到危险。

sentences.en: Although some smoke was visible, it was mostly obscured by a large ridge behind his house and there was no odour in the air.
sentences.zh: 虽然能看到一些烟雾，但大部分被他房子后面的一道大山脊遮挡，空气中也没有异味。

sentences.en: His father-in-law phoned a second time at about 4pm, telling him that the fire was moving in his direction and to prepare to leave.
sentences.zh: 岳父在下午4点左右第二次打来电话，告诉他火势正朝他的方向移动，让他准备离开。

sentences.en: Martin responded that the fire was not there yet, but he was ready to go.
sentences.zh: 马丁回应说火还没到，但他已经准备好出发了。

sentences.en: An hour later, he spoke to his ex-wife Rachel, asking if she wanted him to pack anything in the car before he left the property.
sentences.zh: 一小时后，他与前妻雷切尔通了电话，问她在离开房产前是否需要他在车里装点什么。

sentences.en: She pressed him to leave immediately, but Martin assured her that it wasn't that bad as the fire wasn't there yet.
sentences.zh: 她催促他立即离开，但马丁向她保证情况没那么糟，因为火还没到那里。

sentences.en: Martin then spoke to his sister on the phone, who encouraged her brother to act intuitively, despite the Country Fire Authority's website deeming the area safe.
sentences.zh: 马丁随后在电话里与姐姐交谈，姐姐鼓励弟弟凭直觉行事，尽管乡村消防局的网站认为该地区是安全的。

sentences.en: She called back a short time later to warn him about the anticipated wind change.
sentences.zh: 不久后她又打来电话，警告他关于预期的风向转变。

sentences.en: Martin told me if the wind came from the south, he was screwed, and that he was going to leave.
sentences.zh: 马丁告诉我，如果风从南边吹来，他就完了，他打算离开。

sentences.en: At 6.40pm,
sentences.zh: 下午6点40分，

sentences.zh: 马丁再次给前妻打电话，告诉她他已经在车里了。

sentences.en: Rachel recalled,
sentences.zh: 雷切尔回忆道：

sentences.zh: 她指示马丁去她父亲家。

sentences.en: This was the last anyone heard from Martin Schultz and he was registered as a missing person the following day.
sentences.zh: 这是最后一次有人听到马丁·舒尔茨的消息，第二天他被登记为失踪人员。

sentences.en: Almost a week later,
sentences.zh: 近一周后，

sentences.en: Martin's body, along with that of his dog, was found in his burnt-out car in a creek bed three kilometres from his home.
sentences.zh: 马丁的遗体连同他的狗，在他家三公里外河床上一辆烧毁的汽车里被发现。

sentences.en: Gertrude and Eric Martin immigrated to Australia from Germany in 1956,
sentences.zh: 格特鲁德和埃里克·马丁于1956年从德国移民到澳大利亚，

sentences.en: bringing with them their two children before having their third in Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 带着他们的两个孩子，之后在墨尔本生下了第三个孩子。

sentences.en: In 1973, the Martins purchased the dilapidated old dairy farm on Jiralang North Road in Jiralang, then set about fixing up its weatherboard and cement sheet home.
sentences.zh: 1973年，马丁夫妇买下了吉拉朗北路上一家破旧的老奶牛场，然后着手修缮其木板和水泥板结构的房屋。

sentences.en: They added a woodgrain extension and filled the surrounding garden with ornamental trees and shrubs.
sentences.zh: 他们增加了一个木纹扩建部分，并在周围的花园里种满了观赏树木和灌木。

sentences.en: The pair worked on the farm for 30 years, but had recently settled down when Gertrude's health declined.
sentences.zh: 两人在农场工作了30年，但最近随着格特鲁德健康状况恶化，他们安定了下来。

sentences.en: At 80 years old, she suffered from a heart condition, high blood pressure, and had trouble with her hips.
sentences.zh: 80岁时，她患有心脏病、高血压，且髋部有问题。

sentences.en: Eric was aware of the fire danger forecast for February 7, 2009, and spent the morning making final preparations to defend his home.

sentences.en: Realising there was no hope to defend their home,
sentences.zh: 意识到保卫家园已无望，

sentences.en: Eric guided Gertrude towards a rear door that led out to the back porch.
sentences.zh: 埃里克引导格特鲁德走向通往后廊的后门。

sentences.en: When he opened the door, fire immediately shot inside, so he quickly slammed it shut, later explaining,
sentences.zh: 当他打开门时，火焰立即射入屋内，他迅速猛地关上门，后来解释说：

sentences.en: I don't know how long we waited, but the house was burning and everything around us was burning.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我们等了多久，但房子在燃烧，我们周围的一切都在燃烧。

sentences.en: After a minute or two, I tried the door again and the flames were totally gone.
sentences.zh: 一两分钟后，我再次尝试开门，火焰已经完全消失了。

sentences.en: When the blaze subsided,
sentences.zh: 当大火平息后，

sentences.en: Eric placed a wet towel over his wife's head and headed back to the house to extinguish several spot fires.
sentences.zh: 埃里克把一条湿毛巾盖在妻子头上，又回到房子去扑灭几处零星火点。

sentences.en: Upon returning to Gertrude minutes later, he found her lying on the ground as though she was sleeping.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后回到格特鲁德身边时，他发现她躺在地上，仿佛睡着了一样。

sentences.en: Eric held her hand, only to realise she had passed away.

sentences.en: It was later determined that Gertrude Martin had died as a result of a heart attack.

sentences.zh: 急救人员报告称，该地区有两处平行的火源在燃烧，随后汇聚成一场灾难性的火灾。

sentences.en: The second had arisen from a pile of discarded junk that included old tyres, mattresses and faulty bicycles, none of which were capable of self-igniting.
sentences.zh: 第二处源于一堆废弃的垃圾，包括旧轮胎、床垫和坏掉的自行车，这些东西都不具备自燃能力。

sentences.en: All scenarios, including that the fires had been caused by car exhausts, campfires, broken glass, lightning strikes or discarded cigarettes, were explored and ultimately rejected.
sentences.zh: 所有假设，包括火灾是由汽车尾气、篝火、碎玻璃、雷击或丢弃的香烟引起的，都经过了探索并最终被排除。

sentences.en: The possibility that embers from one fire had started the other was also ruled out as both blazes arose in quick succession and it typically takes upwards of 15 to 20 minutes
sentences.zh: 一处火源的余烬引发另一处的可能性也被排除，因为两场大火接连发生，通常需要15到20分钟以上的时间

sentences.en: for such spreading to occur.

sentences.en: Arson detectives were certain the Churchill fire had been deliberately lit.

sentences.zh: 我失去了母亲米罗斯，失去了父亲艾伦，还有我的兄弟

sentences.zh: 卢克，他是我最好的朋友。

sentences.zh: 一个人在极端天气条件下
